text:
Incident report

Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502 errors. The failed requests affected customers who called the public API during this period. A deploy removed the cache warmup step at startup. Cold cache reads increased backend latency, and the API gateway returned 502 errors after upstream timeouts. We reverted the deploy at 14:27 UTC. Error rates returned to normal at 14:31 UTC after the cache recovered. We added a deployment guard that blocks releases without the cache warmup step. We will add a startup test for the same path.
